title: The Sunday Read: ‘My Goldendoodle Spent a Week at Some Luxury Dog ‘Hotels.’ I Tagged Along.’

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在清晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空度过的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的外面是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最棒的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端菜谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，访问 nytimes.com 琴线 subscribe。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Sam Apple.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是萨姆·阿普尔。

sentences.en: I'm a contributor to the New York Times Magazine and the owner of a very good golden doodle named Steve who loves neck massages and hard-boiled eggs.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人，还养了一只非常乖的金毛拉都德犬叫史蒂夫，它最喜欢做颈部按摩和水煮蛋。

sentences.en: I've had this feeling for a while now that the dogs are taking over.
sentences.zh: 我有一种感觉有一段时间了，那就是狗正在接管一切。

sentences.en: All these activities where you never see dogs in the past, now you're seeing people bring them everywhere they go.
sentences.zh: 所有这些过去绝不会看到狗的活动，现在你看到人们无论去哪儿都把它们带着。

sentences.en: Restaurants have dog tasting menus.
sentences.zh: 餐馆提供狗狗品鉴菜单。

sentences.en: There are ice cream parlors specifically for dogs.
sentences.zh: 有专门为狗狗开的冰淇淋店。

sentences.en: We dressed them up in Halloween costumes, which a decade ago might have been a joke.
sentences.zh: 我们给它们穿上万圣节服装，十年前这可能还是个笑话。

sentences.en: Now it's like, of course you buy your dog a Halloween costume.
sentences.zh: 现在感觉就像，你当然会给你的狗买一套万圣节服装。

sentences.en: Who wouldn't do that?
sentences.zh: 谁会不这么做呢？

sentences.en: Recently, I became obsessed with this concept of luxury dog hotels.
sentences.zh: 最近，我迷上了豪华狗酒店这个概念。

sentences.en: Not pet-friendly accommodations for people, but upscale dog kennels essentially that are nicer than some human hotels.
sentences.zh: 不是为人提供宠物友好住宿，本质上是比某些人类酒店还要豪华的高档狗舍。

sentences.en: There are these high-end resorts with names like Chateau Poochee and Barkingham Pet Hotel where your dog can luxuriate while you're off on vacation.
sentences.zh: 有这些名字叫“波奇城堡”和“巴金汉宠物酒店”的高端度假村，你的狗可以在那里享受奢华，而你则去度假。

sentences.en: Hotel staff will take your dog on nature walks, read them bedtime stories, and perform belly-rubbed tuck-ins.
sentences.zh: 酒店员工会带你的狗去自然散步、给它们读睡前故事，并进行拍肚皮式的道晚安服务。

sentences.en: The amenities some of these places offer are pretty astounding.
sentences.zh: 其中一些地方提供的设施相当惊人。

sentences.en: Queen-size beds, big flat-screen TVs, swimming pools, and they're often filled with chic decor.
sentences.zh: 特大号床、大屏幕电视、游泳池，而且通常装点着时尚的装饰。

sentences.en: The most lavish dog hotels include spas where your dog can get a blueberry facial, a mud bath, or a massage.
sentences.zh: 最奢华的狗酒店配有水疗中心，你的狗可以在那里享受蓝莓面部护理、泥浴或按摩。

sentences.en: According to one franchise's website, relaxing, down-tempo-slash-chill music emanates throughout the entire hotel, creating a peaceful vibe for the canine guests.
sentences.zh: 根据某连锁店网站的介绍，放松的、慢节奏加舒缓的音乐在整个酒店回荡，为犬类客人营造出一种宁静的氛围。

sentences.en: The same franchise will pick your dog up in a Lamborghini or other sports car of your choice.
sentences.zh: 同一家连锁店会用兰博基尼或你选择的其他跑车来接你的狗。

sentences.en: Why is it so different from the way we grew up?
sentences.zh: 为什么这跟我们成长的方式如此不同？

sentences.en: I decided to go on a road trip with Steve so that we could try out some of these dog hotels ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我决定和史蒂夫一起去自驾游，这样我们就可以亲自体验其中一些狗酒店。

sentences.en: I packed the car with Steve's stuffed mallard, one of his favorite toys, a big bag of hard-boiled eggs, and a sleeping bag.
sentences.zh: 我在车里塞满了史蒂夫的毛绒野鸭（他最喜欢的玩具之一）、一大袋水煮蛋和一个睡袋。

sentences.en: The result is this week's Sunday read, read by Eric Jason Martin.
sentences.zh: 结果就是本周的周日阅读，由埃里克·杰森·马丁朗读。

sentences.en: Our audio producer for this episode is Adrian HurSt.
sentences.zh: 我们这一集的音频制作人是阿德里安·赫斯特。

sentences.en: The original music you'll hear was written and performed by Aaron Esposito.
sentences.zh: 你将听到的原创音乐由亚伦·埃斯波西托创作和演奏。

sentences.en: By the time my golden doodle, Steve, and I pulled up to our resting place, I was tired from the long drive and already second-guessing my plan.
sentences.zh: 当我的金毛拉都德犬史蒂夫和我把车开到我们的休息地时，长途开车让我感到疲惫，并且我已经开始对我的计划产生怀疑了。

sentences.en: I felt a little better when we stepped inside the
sentences.zh: 当我们走进去时，我感觉好受了一点

sentences.en: Dogwood Acres Pet Retreat.
sentences.zh: 山茱萸英亩宠物度假村。

sentences.en: The lobby, with its elegant tiled entrance, might have passed for the lobby of any small countryside hotel, at least one that strongly favored dog-themed decor,
sentences.zh: 大堂有着优雅的瓷砖入口，看起来完全可以是一家小型乡村酒店的大堂，至少是一家极度偏爱狗狗主题装饰的酒店，

sentences.en: but this illusion was broken when the receptionist reviewed our reservation, which, in addition to our luxury suite, included cuddle time, group play, a nature walk,
sentences.zh: 但当接待员核对我们的预订时，这个幻觉就破灭了，除了豪华套房外，预订还包括拥抱时间、集体玩耍、自然散步，

sentences.en: and a belly rub tuck-in.
sentences.zh: 以及拍肚皮道晚安服务。

sentences.en: Venues like this one, located on Kent Island in Maryland's Chesapeake Bay, didn't exist when I was growing up in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 像这样的地方位于马里兰州切萨皮克湾的肯特岛，在我于20世纪80年代长大时并不存在。

sentences.en: If you needed a place to board your dog back then, you went to a kennel, where your dog spent virtually the entire day in a small, and probably not very clean, cage.
sentences.zh: 如果你那时需要找个地方寄养你的狗，你会去一个狗舍，你的狗几乎一整天都在一个小而且可能不太干净的笼子里度过。

sentences.en: There were no tuck-ins, no bedtime stories, no dog-bone-shaped swimming pools.
sentences.zh: 没有道晚安，没有睡前故事，没有狗骨头形状的游泳池。

sentences.en: There were certainly nothing like today's most upscale canine resorts, where the dogs sleep on queen-size beds, and the spa offerings include mud baths and blueberry facials.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有像今天最豪华的犬类度假村那样的地方，狗睡在特大号床上，水疗服务包括泥浴和蓝莓面部护理。

sentences.en: One pet hotel franchise on the West Coast will even pick up your dog in a Lamborghini.
sentences.zh: 西海岸的一家宠物酒店连锁甚至会用兰博基尼来接你的狗。

sentences.en: I knew dogwood acres wouldn't be quite as luxurious as that, but the accommodations still sounded pretty nice.
sentences.zh: 我知道山茱萸英亩不会像那样豪华，但住宿听起来依然相当不错。

sentences.en: The website mentioned distinctive decor, cable television, and a large picture window overlooking an extra-large private outdoor patio.
sentences.zh: 网站提到了独特的装饰、有线电视，以及俯瞰超大私人室外露台的大型落地窗。

sentences.en: My plan was to stay with Steve at a string of dog hotels.
sentences.zh: 我的计划是和史蒂夫一起入住一连串的狗酒店。

sentences.en: Yes, four dogs only, in the mid-Atlantic region, not too far from where I live.
sentences.zh: 是的，仅限狗狗，位于大西洋中部地区，离我住的地方不太远。

sentences.en: Putting the plan into action had required making a series of deeply embarrassing phone calls.
sentences.zh: 付诸行动需要打一连串极其尴尬的电话。

sentences.en: My requests were sometimes met with awkward silences, which would be followed by questions along the lines of, you sure you want to do that?
sentences.zh: 我的要求有时会遭遇尴尬的沉默，随后会出现类似“你确定要这么做吗？”的问题。

sentences.en: I tried to explain that staying at dog hotels would take me to the heart of some questions that I'd been thinking about a lot in recent months.
sentences.zh: 我试图解释说，住狗酒店会让我触及一些我近几个月一直在深思的问题。

sentences.en: How did humans start catering to the whims of canines rather than the other way around?
sentences.zh: 人类是如何开始迎合犬类的奇思妙想，而不是反过来的？

sentences.en: And what if, somewhere along the way, we all became a little too obsessed with our dogs?
sentences.zh: 如果不知不觉中，我们所有人都对我们的狗变得有点太着迷了呢？

sentences.en: After Steve was weighed and examined for fleas and ticks, we were escorted to our room.
sentences.zh: 在史蒂夫被称重并检查过是否有跳蚤和壁虱后，我们被护送进房间。

sentences.en: Everyone at Dogwood Acres was exceptionally warm and welcoming, which did nothing to lessen my fear as I walked by them, clutching my sleeping bag and rolling suitcase,
sentences.zh: 山茱萸英亩的每个人都异常热情和欢迎，但这并没有减少我走过他们身边时心中的恐惧，我紧紧攥着睡袋和拉杆箱，

sentences.en: that they all thought I was a total schmuck.
sentences.zh: 担心他们觉得我简直是个大笨蛋。

sentences.en: I wanted to take each employee aside and explain that it wasn't what it seemed, that I was actually on a very serious quest to understand something important
sentences.zh: 我想把每个员工拉到一边解释说这并非表面看起来那样，我实际上是在进行一项非常严肃的探索，为了理解一些重要的事情

sentences.en: about the American condition in the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 关于21世纪的美国状况。

sentences.en: But there was nothing to be done, because, of course, the only thing schmuckier than staying at a facility for dogs is trying to justify it as a quest to understand
sentences.zh: 但无济于事，因为当然，比住在狗狗设施里更蠢的事，就是试图将其合理化为一项旨在理解

sentences.en: something important about the American condition in the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 21世纪美国状况的重要事情的探索。

sentences.en: I tried to remain positive as Steve and I made our way into the recesses of Dogwood Acres, never mind if the hallway of luxury suites had less the feel of the Ritz-Carlton
sentences.zh: 我和史蒂夫走进山茱萸英亩的深处时，我努力保持积极心态，哪怕豪华套房走廊给人的感觉与其说是丽思卡尔顿，

sentences.en: than of, say, a Soviet-era
sentences.zh: 不如说是，比方说，苏联时期的

sentences.en: Bulgarian office building.
sentences.zh: 保加利亚办公楼。

sentences.en: So what if the room directly across from our suite was occupied by a large black dog named Bella who was barking ferociously and lunging at the window facing our room?
sentences.zh: 即使我们套房正对面的房间住着一只名叫贝拉的大黑狗，它正狂吠不止并向着朝向我们房间的窗户扑来，又有什么关系呢？

sentences.en: What difference did it make that someone had used a black marker to add some all-caps notes to the printed chart taped to Bella's door?
sentences.zh: 有人用黑色记号笔在贴在贝拉门上的打印图表上加了一些全大写的便条，这有什么区别呢？

sentences.en: Do not reach for head.
sentences.zh: 切勿触碰头部。

sentences.en: Caution with sudden movements.
sentences.zh: 防范突然动作。

sentences.en: Did it really matter that our room was significantly smaller than I anticipated
sentences.zh: 我们的房间明显比我预期的要小，

sentences.en: 6.5 feet by 6.5 feet or that the extra-large private outdoor patio was surrounded by steel caging?
sentences.zh: 6.5英尺乘以6.5英尺，或者超大的私人室外露台四周围着钢笼，这真的重要吗？

sentences.en: It could have been worse.
sentences.zh: 情况可能更糟。

sentences.en: I had my sleeping bag, there was a TV, and an elegant stainless steel pail of water should Steve or I get thirsty.
sentences.zh: 我有睡袋，有电视，万一我和史蒂夫口渴了，还有一个优雅的不锈钢水桶。

sentences.en: It was all, of course, entirely my own fault.
sentences.zh: 当然，这一切完全是我自找的。

sentences.en: Audrey Reichardt, the owner, had graciously offered to set up a cot and air mattress for me, but I insisted I wanted only what the dogs get.
sentences.zh: 老板奥黛丽·赖查特好心地提出为我架设一张小折叠床和充气床垫，但我坚持我只要狗狗们得到的待遇。

sentences.en: This is it,
sentences.zh: 就是这样，

sentences.en: Reichardt said, extending her hand to the room.
sentences.zh: 赖查特伸手指着房间说。

sentences.en: But you're not a dog.
sentences.zh: 但你不是狗。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game
sentences.zh: 我编写游戏

sentences.en: Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 《连线》，《纽约时报》游戏中的一个谜题，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作

sentences.en: Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis, and I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 《拼字蜂》和《字母连字》游戏，我有一种叫做色彩联觉的病症。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏由人类制作，就像你刚刚听到那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com 琴线 games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: A little while later, a young woman came by to give Steve his bedtime belly rub tuck-in.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，一位年轻女子顺道过来给史蒂夫做睡前拍肚皮道晚安服务。

sentences.en: Watching by the open door, I couldn't help thinking that if only humans were good and innocent like dogs, instead of being so weird and gross and sex-obsessed,
sentences.zh: 我在开着的门旁看着，忍不住在想，如果人类能像狗一样善良单纯，而不是那么怪异、恶心且满脑子性欲，

sentences.en: we might have a wider range of wholesome services like this one available at our hotels.
sentences.zh: 我们的酒店里也许就会提供更广泛的此类有益身心的服务。

sentences.en: Then I remembered that Steve might not be so good and pure around his own kind either, had I not had his testicles surgically removed.
sentences.zh: 然后我想起，如果我没有切除史蒂夫的睾丸，它在同类面前可能也并非那么善良纯洁。

sentences.en: At 8 p.m., it was lights out.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点，熄灯了。

sentences.en: Steve got onto his dog cot with the stuffed mallard toy
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫爬上了它的狗床，带着我打包的

sentences.en: I'd packed.
sentences.zh: 毛绒野鸭玩具。

sentences.en: A few minutes later, I heard some deep breathing and saw that Steve was out cold, which made the whole experience lonelier, like when a friend would fall asleep first
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，我听到一阵深沉的呼吸声，看到史蒂夫已经睡得死死的，这让整个经历显得更加孤独，就像在睡衣派对上朋友先睡着了一样。

sentences.en: at a sleepover.
sentences.zh: 睡衣派对。

sentences.en: At some point, I remembered that I hadn't eaten all day.
sentences.zh: 某个时刻，我想起我一整天都没吃东西。

sentences.en: I took a few hard-boiled eggs out of my bag and looked through the window to the patio slash steel cage and felt it really should have been impossible, even schmuckier than before.
sentences.zh: 我从包里掏出几个水煮蛋，透过窗户看着露台加钢笼，觉得这实在太荒谬了，比之前还要像个大笨蛋。

sentences.en: It's not just the hotels.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是酒店。

sentences.en: There are now dog bakeries and ice cream parlors and social clubs.
sentences.zh: 现在还有狗狗面包店、冰淇淋店和社交俱乐部。

sentences.en: One dog-only San Francisco cafe serves canines as a $75 tasting menu.
sentences.zh: 旧金山一家仅限狗狗的咖啡馆为犬类提供75美元的品鉴菜单。

sentences.en: More and more restaurants, for people, also now offer dog menus.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的面向人类的餐馆现在也提供狗狗菜单。

sentences.en: A lot of these things probably started as jokes, but such gestures have a way of outliving their origins.
sentences.zh: 其中许多事情最初可能只是笑话，但这种姿态往往比它们的起源活得更久。

sentences.en: At some point, throwing birthday parties for our dogs and buying them
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，为我们的狗举办生日派对并给它们买

sentences.en: Valentine's Day gifts went from being something we did to be funny to something we just did.
sentences.zh: 情人节礼物，从一件为了搞笑而做的事变成了一件我们习以为常的事。

sentences.en: Total spending on pets in the United States, and dogs are by far the most popular pet, rose more than 50% between 2018 and 2022 when it reached $137 billion,
sentences.zh: 根据宠物产品贸易协会的数据，美国人在宠物上的总开支——狗是迄今为止最受欢迎的宠物——在2018年至2022年间增长了50%以上，达到1370亿美元。

sentences.en: according to a pet products trade association.
sentences.zh: 宠物产品贸易协会。

sentences.en: Americans now spend more than half a billion dollars each year on pet Halloween costumes alone, per the National Retail Federation.
sentences.zh: 根据全国零售联合会的数据，美国人现在每年仅在宠物万圣节服装上就花费超过五亿美元。

sentences.en: This sharp spending increase overlaps with Americans spending approximately twice as much time with pets today as they did two decades ago.
sentences.zh: 这一急剧增长的开支与美国人陪伴宠物的时间大约是二十年前的两倍这一现象相重叠。

sentences.en: A 2023 survey found that around half of American owners believe their pet knows them better than anyone else does, including significant others and best friends.
sentences.zh: 2023年的一项调查发现，大约一半的美国主人相信他们的宠物比任何其他人（包括另一半和最好朋友）都更了解他们。

sentences.en: These statistics sit uncomfortably alongside the fact that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些统计数据与美国

sentences.en: Surgeon General recently declared human loneliness an epidemic.
sentences.zh: 外科医生总监最近宣布人类孤独感已成为一种流行病这一事实形成了令人不安的对照。

sentences.en: It's hard not to wonder whether our growing obsession with dogs is somehow related to our declining interest in one another.
sentences.zh: 我们很难不产生疑问：我们对狗日益增长的痴迷是否与我们对彼此日益下降的兴趣有关？

sentences.en: Maybe, even as we're humanizing our dogs, the deeper appeal is not that they're like people, but that they're not like people.
sentences.zh: 也许，即便我们在将狗拟人化，更深层的吸引力也不是因为它们像人，而是因为它们不像人。

sentences.en: Maybe, if you dig far enough beneath the surface of our dog love, you eventually arrive at a thin layer of misanthropy.
sentences.zh: 也许，如果你在我们对狗的爱之表象下深挖足够多，你最终会触及一层薄薄的厌世情绪。

sentences.en: My interest in America's dog mania wasn't only sociological.
sentences.zh: 我对美国狂热养狗的兴趣不仅限于社会学。

sentences.en: Several months before our trip, I found a small lump on Steve's right hind leg.
sentences.zh: 在我们旅行前几个月，我在史蒂夫的右后腿上发现了一个小肿块。

sentences.en: The tumor turned out to be benign, but the experience left me profoundly shaken.
sentences.zh: 肿瘤结果是良性的，但这段经历让我深受震动。

sentences.en: When the veterinary surgeon told me she thought it was cancer, I had to sit in the car for ten minutes to regain my composure before driving home.
sentences.zh: 当兽医外科医生告诉我她认为是癌症时，我在车里坐了十分钟，平复了情绪才开车回家。

sentences.en: Every time I looked over and saw Steve's breathtakingly goofy face encircled by his dumb plastic cone, I started to cry again.
sentences.zh: 每次我转头看到史蒂夫那张被愚蠢的塑料伊丽莎白圈围着的、令人叹为观止的滑稽面孔时，我就又开始哭起来。

sentences.en: Before this cancer scare, I probably would have said that the expanding place of dogs in American life was a good thing, that a world that revolves around dogs is a better world.
sentences.zh: 在这场癌症惊魂之前，我可能会说狗在美国生活中不断扩大的地位是一件好事，一个围绕着狗旋转的世界是一个更好的世界。

sentences.en: It was only after I realized how unready I was to lose Steve that I found myself wondering if the problem with our current dog mania might run deeper than I'd thought.
sentences.zh: 直到我意识到自己对失去史蒂夫毫无准备之后，我才开始琢磨，我们当前对狗的狂热所存在的问题可能比我想象的要深。

sentences.en: I don't think of myself as particularly lonely, but I don't get together with friends in person very often anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得自己特别孤独，但我现在不再经常和朋友亲自聚会了。

sentences.en: The phone calls I used to have with friends have been replaced by texts.
sentences.zh: 我过去常和朋友打的电话已经被短信取代了。

sentences.zh: 我通常在家工作，在典型的工作日里，

sentences.en: I interact with many more people on Zoom than in real life.
sentences.zh: 我在Zoom上互动的人数远多于现实生活。

sentences.en: If I need the comfort of another beating heart, the closest one around is inside Steve's ribcage.
sentences.zh: 如果我需要一颗跳动的心脏带来的慰藉，周围最近的那一颗就在史蒂夫的胸腔里。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, if less human connection is driving us to form deeper bonds with our dogs, it's hard to conclude that dogs are actually solving our probleMs.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，如果更少的人类联系驱使我们与狗建立更深厚的纽带，我们很难得出结论认为狗实际上正在解决我们的问题。

sentences.en: The most surprising finding in the field of anthrozoology, which studies human-animal relationships, might be that there's no conclusive link between pets and well-being.
sentences.zh: 研究人与动物关系的动物人类学领域最惊人的发现，可能在于宠物与幸福感之间并没有决定性的关联。

sentences.en: Megan Mueller at Tufts University discovered that pet owners were twice as likely to report being depressed as those without pets.
sentences.zh: 塔夫茨大学的梅根·穆勒发现，宠物主人报告抑郁的可能性是没有宠物的人的两倍。

sentences.en: The finding was only an association.
sentences.zh: 这一发现只是一种关联。

sentences.en: We can't really say whether pets are responsible for that depression or if depressed people are simply more likely to have pets.
sentences.zh: 我们无法真正断言是宠物导致了这种抑郁，还是抑郁的人本身就更有可能养宠物。

sentences.en: Still, the mismatch between our personal experience with the animals that we love and what the research says is a complete mystery.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我们对所爱动物的个人体验与研究结果之间的不匹配完全是一个谜。

sentences.en: Hal Herzog, an anthrozoologist and emeritus professor, at Western Carolina University, told me.
